Subject BANE: one battered steel sword pointing diagonally upward whose blade is burdened and dimmed by three heavy smoky violet-black bands curling tightly around it. A small downward drooping black-violet wisp at the tip suggests a curse weakening attacks, not destroying the sword. Sword remains intact and metallic, dark violet magic dominates. No padlock, no chains binding a person, no wounds, no numbers, no text, no frame, no scenery. Compact square arrangement with generous transparent margins.

Subject COMMAND: a large authoritative human hand extends a single index finger horizontally toward a much smaller kneeling humanoid silhouette.
